description: Tells whether a slug (the readable name in <slug or id>.neblla.app) is valid and free for the app, and changes nothing: { available, reason }. When another app of the same developer holds it (its slug or an old one), `reason` is "yours" with `heldBy`; neblla_set_slug with move: true takes it from that app.

slug.description: Wanted slug (lowercase letters, digits, dashes), at least 5 characters

name: neblla_check_slug
title: Check slug
